blueprintSignals.name: Open-shift age and fill hazard
blueprintSignals.definition: hours since posting and historical fill rate for that role and shift type
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use posting time and fill time as logged

blueprintSignals.name: Absence pressure
blueprintSignals.definition: notified absences and aggregate sick-call rate for the unit-shift
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Count only absences notified before scoring time

blueprintSignals.name: Eligible float depth
blueprintSignals.definition: number of eligible float or cross-trained staff available for the shift
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Eligibility must come from verified credentials at that date

blueprintSignals.name: Demand-to-roster margin
blueprintSignals.definition: forecast required hours minus rostered hours for the unit-shift
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use the roster and forecast snapshots from scoring time

label: For "Staffing Coverage Gap Prediction": Predict which upcoming shifts are likely to fall below minimum safe coverage or the required skill mix early enough to act, keeping a forecast risk distinct from a confirmed uncovered shift. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Counting filled shifts as false positives.
